title: {{vocab.firm}}: how a {{vocab.payment}} earns trust
subtitle: Your {{cast.agent}} books trips for you and asks for more trust as the fare and the risk rise. Each rung needs its own proof.

cast.approver: the trip app on the traveller's phone

rungs.name: Traveller signed in
rungs.needs: A sign-in from {{cast.provider}}, fresh for one hour.

rungs.name: Traveller verified
rungs.needs: A fresh identity check (5 minutes). {{vocab.payments}} up to 600.

rungs.name: Fare approved
rungs.needs: An approval from the {{vocab.approver}}, single use, 2 minutes. {{vocab.payments}} up to 1000.

ui.phoneNote: This stands in for {{cast.approver}}. Nothing is booked until that app approves or declines it.

outcome.approved: The {{vocab.approver}} approved. Trust level 3: confirm the {{vocab.payment}} now.
outcome.denied: The {{vocab.approver}} declined the request. The {{vocab.payment}} stays unconfirmed.
outcome.approval_expired: The approval window ended before the {{vocab.payment}} was confirmed.
